Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for BITS Pilani Project Associate I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Project Associate-I. This is a contractual position offered by BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Associate-I position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The last date for the walk-in interview is 11 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Sc./ M.S./ M.Phil with 60% aggregate or a PhD in Organic Chemistry/General Chemistry/Materials Science.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary offered for the Project Associate-I position ranges from Rs. 25,000 to Rs. 37,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for BITS Pilani Recruitment 2026 scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held in Goa. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.
